source: RFC 8785, section 3.2.2 (serialization of primitive data types) and section 3.2.3 (sorting of object properties)
about: input: the JSON text of the example; output: its RFC 8785 canonical text; refused: where KR-10 refuses the input - 1E30 is an integer outside +-(2^53-1) (G-20), U+FB33 is not in NFC

examples.input:
{
  "\u20ac": "Euro Sign",
  "\r": "Carriage Return",
  "\ufb33": "Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh",
  "1": "One",
  "\ud83d\ude00": "Emoji: Grinning Face",
  "\u0080": "Control",
  "\u00f6": "Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"
}
